name: The Life Ark
summary:
In the beginning there was nothing, just dust and empty space. In time, over millions of years this dust joined to form celestial objects in the vast darkness. But something was missing: life.Beings from another dimension found this dead universe and brought life with them to one lonely planet.
Your objective is to continue the work of the aliens and build an inter-dimensional ark to spread life in this world. Solve puzzles, click click click and see where that gets you.
